assertion.statement: Crossplane v2 makes all managed resources (MRs) namespaced, enabling a namespaced XR to consist entirely of namespaced resources, and the upgrade guide lists this as a v2 feature to start using via the managed resources getting started guide.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence states no exposure condition, and the change applies to 'all managed resources' across every provider's resource kinds, which no available predicate (gvk-in-use needs a specific group/version/kind) can express generically.; consequence: The evidence describes the capability positively and the upgrade-guide line only suggests trying a getting-started guide; neither excerpt states what happens to an environment whose operator does nothing (e.g. whether existing cluster-scoped managed resources keep working or must be migrated).
